description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Work alongside external engineering teams at their own sites to scope technical problems, then build software with them and keep it running within their environment. The role pairs direct ownership of a customer account with hands-on coding inside established design workflows.
 What you'll do
 - Spend time at customer sites or nearby, working with their design and verification teams to create new tools together.
 - Take end-to-end responsibility for an account, from scoping the problem to a finished product in daily use.
 - Collaborate with internal research engineers, domain specialists and customer champions to turn problems found in the field into delivered tools.
 - Write software that links a product to customer development environments, including code, test benches, simulators and verification setups.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Prior employment or internship experience at a semiconductor or electronic design automation company, or in chip or design verification.
 - Practical command of Verilog, SystemVerilog and register-level hardware design.
 Bonus points
 - Earlier customer-facing engineering experience.
 - Formal training in a technical discipline, or comparable practical background.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 180,000 to 300,000 per year
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - San Jose, CA, United States
 - Onsite
 - Full-time
 - Includes roughly 1 to 2 customer site visits per week
